content.text: The audit clause meets the preferred position on every material term.

input.quote: Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only provision giving Vendor audit rights over us (Section 23 contains no operative text). It matches the preferred position on all material terms: frequency limited to once per twelve months, thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (22.1); Vendor bears costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent (22.2); and Vendor and its auditor are expressly barred from direct access to Customer systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material, and other suppliers' confidential information (22.2). Section 22.3 additionally protects findings as our Confidential Information. No redline needed.
